wings-shop-description: Permanently unlock flight and the Angel Wings appearance. They are equipped automatically. Buy once per character.
wings-locked: Buy Angel Wings for 1000g at Hat Mouse's shop in Cindersap Forest to learn to fly.
wings-acquired: You acquired Angel Wings! Flight is permanently unlocked for this character, and the Angel Wings appearance is equipped.
wings-tutorial-toggle: To use: press {{toggle}} to summon your wings and take off. To put them away: press {{toggle}} again to land on safe ground and fold your wings. Controller: tap and release {{pad}} to take off or land.
wings-tutorial-toggle-keyboard: To use: press {{toggle}} to summon your wings and take off. To put them away: press {{toggle}} again to land on safe ground and fold your wings.
wings-tutorial-recover: Emergency recovery: if you get stuck, press {{recover}} to return to safe ground, or hold {{pad}} for 1.2 seconds on a controller.
wings-tutorial-recover-keyboard: Emergency recovery: if you get stuck, press {{recover}} to return to safe ground.
wings-help-again: You can read these instructions again under Options > Controls.
single-player: Angel Wings only supports the main player while no other players are connected.
cannot-start: Summon wings while free to move on safe ground.
cannot-land: No safe landing here. Fly to clear ground first.
landing-after-action: Landing queued. The ground will be checked after the current action ends.
swim-after-action: Water entry queued. Your current action or takeoff must finish first. Press the flight button again to cancel.
swim-unavailable: Water entry could not complete here. Keep flying to a clear landing spot.
swim-surface-first: Please return to the surface before opening your wings.
swim-wait-transition: Wait for the water entry or shore exit animation to finish before opening your wings.
swim-takeoff-unavailable: You cannot take off safely here. Swim to open water or return to shore and try again.
recovery-failed: No safe recovery spot found. Keep the wings enabled and contact the author with your log.
controls-toggle-title: Angel Wings: summon / take off / land
controls-ground-detail: Auto-climb over fences; flight continues across normal map changes. No landing on water or fences.
controls-ground-detail-swim: Auto-climb over fences; normal map changes keep flight. Over permitted surface water, the flight button switches between flight and swimming. Surface before taking off from a dive.
controls-fishing-detail: Talk, fish and use tools normally. Manual landing waits for tool actions to end.
wing-item-description: Can be hung on an indoor wall. While grounded, right-click these wings in your inventory or use the action button on a wall display to swap them with your equipped wings.
wing-already-equipped: You are already wearing these wings.
haley-flower-letter: Hi, @!^^I've been dreaming of a field of flowers. Would you let {{required}} flowers bloom on your farm at the same time in exchange for a mysterious gift? Any flowers will do—I want a whole sea of color.^^    —Haley
haley-flower-quest-description: Haley wants to photograph a colorful sea of flowers. Have {{required}} flowers blooming at the same time on {{farmName}} Farm. Any flower crop counts.
haley-flower-objective: Harvest-ready flowers outdoors on the main farm and in the greenhouse: {{count}} / {{required}}
haley-flower-objective-ready: The flower sea is in bloom. Talk to Haley.
haley-flower-completion-dialogue: I saw that field of flowers when I passed your farm... It was so beautiful!#$b#I took lots of lovely photos, too.#$b#Thank you for doing this for me. Here's the mysterious gift I promised. I think it'll look perfect on you.
